title: Sun-type determinant and permanent congruences
summary: Sun proposed a list of congruence and quadratic-residue conjectures for determinants and permanents over residue classes modulo a prime. This article gives a uniform treatment of Conjectures 4.6, 4.7, 4.8(ii), 4.9, 4.10(ii), 4.11 and 4.12 from Sun's list, while making explicit the overlap with two earlier contributions. Luo and Xia's Legendre-symbol formula for $D_p(b,1)$ already implies the non-vanishing assertion in Conjecture 4.6 when $p\equiv5\pmod {24}$; our determinant argument gives a root-quotient criterion for irreducible binary quadratic forms over $\Fp$ and also covers the…
